5312 Siltstone Loop is a custom-built luxury estate in Killeen, TX, listed at $795,000 with 4 bedrooms, 3 full and 2 half baths, and more than 4,000 square feet on roughly three-quarters of an acre in White Rock Estates (76542). This is the kind of home most people don't know Killeen has: a true custom estate with the space, the finishes, and the land, minutes from Fort Hood.

Come walk the whole property with me. No fluff, no Zillow guesses. A real look at the layout, the finishes, the lot, and exactly who this home fits.

WHAT YOU'RE LOOKING AT
- 4 bedrooms, 3 full baths, 2 half baths
- More than 4,000 square feet, two stories
- Custom-built in 2014 on approximately 0.72 acres
- 4-car garage
- Primary suite on the main floor
- Solar energy plus energy-efficient HVAC and insulation
- No HOA
- Killeen ISD
- Listed at $795,000 ($194/sqft)
- Killeen, TX 76542

INSIDE THE HOME
- Fully renovated kitchen with double ovens and built-in appliances
- Multiple living areas and a formal dining room
- Dedicated home office
- Upstairs media room
- Sunroom
- Primary suite with sitting area, jetted tub, oversized dual-head walk-in shower, and his-and-hers closets
- Fully tiled upstairs balcony and private sitting area
- New flooring, crown molding, high ceilings, water softener owned

OUTSIDE
- Roughly 0.72-acre lot
- Extended tiled back patio
- Covered and enclosed porch areas
- Privacy fencing with gate
- Brick, masonry, and stucco exterior

THE LOCATION
White Rock Estates sits on the south side of Killeen with a short commute to Fort Hood. Zoned to Maude Moore Wood Elementary, Liberty Hill Middle, and Chaparral High in Killeen ISD. The home accepts Cash, Conventional, FHA, and VA financing, which makes it a strong fit for military families near Fort Hood looking for room and quality without leaving town.
